description: This Java class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named LoanProductBorrowerCycleVariationData for representing variation data related to loan product borrower cycles within the Fineract project. It contains fields for cycle number, parameter type, value condition type, default, minimum, and maximum values, along with accessor methods and methods to retrieve associated enum types.

classes.name: LoanProductBorrowerCycleVariationData
classes.description: A data object representing variation details of loan product borrower cycles, including parameter type, value conditions, and value bounds.

methods.name: LoanProductBorrowerCycleVariationData
methods.description: Constructor initializing all fields with provided values.

methods.name: getLoanProductParamType
methods.description: Returns the enum type of the parameter based on paramType's ID.

methods.name: getLoanProductValueConditionType
methods.description: Returns the enum type indicating the value condition based on valueConditionType's ID.
